messages:
Anya (Design): Quick design question — for the Pools bulk delete flow: do we show inline per-row errors for missing perms, or surface a single top summary after submit? trying to balance scanability + a11y. Olivia (PM): my vote is summary for bulk actions, but include links to rows that failed. users usually want one place to see everything. :point_up: Mike (Eng): summary + anchors seems fine. main concern is keyboard users — we need predictable focus movement after submit so the user lands on the error list or the first failing row. Sam (DevEx): +1 on focus management. also think inline previews for the first N failures helps reduce context switching (e.g., expand the row inline). avoid scrolling surprises. Anya (Design): hmm, expand-first-3 sounds promising. how do we announce that to screen readers? a11y-bot: recommendation: provide an aria-live region for the summary and set focus to the summary container with role="status" after submit. For per-row details, use aria-controls on the summary links and ensure the expanded content has aria-labelledby. Example: ```
3 rows failed
Fix row 7
Permission missing: delete_pool
``` Anya (Design): nice, that helps. what about destructive typed confirms? typed-confirm (type the pool name) vs simple checkbox + toast. Olivia (PM): typed-confirm reduces accidental deletes but is heavy for power users. maybe make it configurable by admin or only required for org-owned pools. Mike (Eng): typed-confirm also has keyboard friction. if we keep it, ensure the input is auto-focused and supports paste. add `autocomplete=off` so browsers don't fill it weird. Sam (DevEx): can we keep the primary CTA disabled until match and show inline validation under the typed input? avoids modals that trap focus forever. :+1: Anya (Design): copy nits: instead of "Type the pool name to confirm", try: "Enter the pool name to permanently delete it." adds "permanently" clarity. a11y-bot: also recommend visible focus styles on the typed input and clear error message with `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` pointing to the helper text. Olivia (PM): summary of decision? Mike (Eng): hybrid error surface: top summary (aria-live, focus moved there) + inline expanded details for first 3 failures with anchors to rows. typed-confirm default off except for org-owned pools, if enabled: auto-focus input, inline validation, clear aria attributes. Anya (Design): I'll mock up the hybrid pattern and the microcopy tweak, will post frames. thanks all! :raised_hands: Sam (DevEx): i'll add keyboard/focus acceptance criteria for the PR. Olivia (PM): I'll update the product spec with the conditional typed-confirm rule. Anya (Design): tagging this for a quick review when mocks are up — @Mike (Eng) @Sam (DevEx) @Olivia (PM) Mike (Eng): ack, will review.
